item.title: Hardware wallet sales in Russia more than double as new crypto rules near

item.description: The spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds registered their third-strongest showing since October as institutional demand showed signs of renewed momentum.

item.title: Brazil's central bank orders exchanges to delay large crypto transfers abroad
item.description: The rule applies to transfers above $10,000 and smaller transactions flagged as risky by exchanges.

item.title: Another Bitcoin infrastructure exploit hits, this time draining Lightning payment servers

item.title: Domestic stablecoins could boost demand for dollar-backed tokens: IMF

item.title: New XRP Ledger amendments target $530 million in tokenized Wall Street assets

item.title: Donald Trump’s media company to terminate Crypto.com deal
